page.overview:
What is Ankhwugaht?

Ankhwugaht was the divine realm of Set, the Pharaonic and Mulhorandi god of evil.

Set actually maintained more than one version of Ankhwugaht. His home realm was the version in Stygia, but there was also the relatively smaller "Ankhwugaht Prime" or "Little Ankhwugaht" in Avernus, and others like it.

Ankhwugaht was a desert realm of poisoned sands, a place of the scorpion's sting and the viper's kiss. Many things might differ between its specific incarnations, but a constant was the prostration before the power of almighty Set.

Ankhwugaht empowered and extended all necromancy spells, although in the Great Wheel cosmology this effect only applied to those used for evil purposes.
